papers.summary: Humanoid motion tracking is central to teleoperation and whole-body imitation, yet evaluation often disagrees with what people perceive in videos. papers.summary: Falls are a major health concern for older adults, and wearable sensors have been widely explored for detecting falls and enabling timely intervention.
